title: The Deepest Hall
journal: The third seal-stone lies in the vault of Vorannuhl's deep halls, behind a door of bronze. Sarpa raiders shelter in the outer yard, and one of them, Hesh-Var, carries the bronze key. I'm to get the key: lift it from him unseen, or kill him and take it.
objectives: Get the Bronze Key of Vorannuhl from Hesh-Var in the outer yard. (marker: Hesh-Var, Vorannuhl)

plan.going: I am hunting the third seal-stone, in Vorannuhl's deep vault, the hardest place of the hunt
plan.next: get the bronze key from Hesh-Var at the yard's fire
plan.ways: pickpocket it from him unseen (Sneak and Pickpocket), or fight the raiders and take it from his body (any fighting skill); the raiders shoot strangers

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka under Never-Writes-Twice. I hold two Seal-Stones (Blackrose, Gemin). The third lies in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and all three go into the gate at Teku-Sul Spire. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is a rival.
Get the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var, a Sarpa raider in the outer yard of Vorannuhl, then open the bronze vault door.
Lift the key from him unseen (pickpocket) or kill him and take it. I favour force. There are also Sarpa raiders and Plague-Dead around.
I do not know why the Unbound seal the trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound. I could find out by exploring and talking to people.

title: The Deepest Hall
journal: I have the Bronze Key of Vorannuhl. The plague-dead of the old household walk the deep halls, and their lord, a wraith, guards the vault. I'm to go down, open the vault with the key and take the stone. I can fight, slip past or turn the dead with Restoration.
objectives: Open the Vault of the Household with the bronze key and take the seal-stone. (marker: Door to Vault of the Household, Household's Hoard)

plan.going: I hold the key; the stone is in the vault below
plan.next: go down, open the vault, take the stone
plan.ways: fight the plague-dead and the wraith-lord; sneak past them; turn them with Restoration

answers: I killed Hesh-Var and have the Bronze Key. Plague-dead of the old household walk the deep halls and a wraith lord guards the vault with the third seal-stone.
Go down to the Vault of the Household door, open it with the key, take the stone.
Fight the dead, slip past them, or turn them with Restoration. I favour force.
I do not know what the wraith lord is or how strong; I could find out by looking when I get there.

title: The Deepest Hall
journal: I took the third seal-stone from the vault of Vorannuhl. I now carry all three seal-stones. Her orders were to bring all three to her before anyone goes near the gate. I'm to bring them to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.

plan.going: I hold all three seal-stones of the Kings' Gate
plan.next: bring them to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom, as her orders said, before going to the gate
plan.ways: none; the report is the step

answers: I now hold all three seal-stones. Never-Writes-Twice ordered me to bring them to her before anyone goes near the gate at Teku-Sul Spire.
Bring them to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.
Go straight there, or first explore other open questions. I will deliver them as ordered.
Still unknown: why the Unbound seal trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound. I could ask in Helstrom.
